notes.title: STEAM SUMMER SALE 2021!
notes.content:
[h1]Breaking news![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27681605/cb2d42a78625370d88972d3e25b36f72dd3d0c66.png[/img]

It's time to celebrate Summer, and from June 24th to July 8th "A Painter's Tale" will be available on Steam with a 50% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/587070/PROTOThYPE___a_love_story/

notes.title: Steam Sales and news!
notes.content:
Hello lovers and welcome!
Today we are happy to announce that >>PROTOTHYPE it's available on Halloween Sales until 1 of November!

- What is PROTOThYPE ?
This is a very short visual narrative experience with some puzzles to solve.

- How much long it's ?
It really depends on you, but if you know what you have to do it's about 30 min.

- It's this a graphic adventure ?
This is a visual experience. A little experiment of pixels created to share some emotions with you.

Hope we can have fun together !
See soon

notes.content:

- Graphical lights  improvements.

Have fun!
